title: Turbo
label: Turbo
desc: Run monorepo tasks in dependency order and reuse their outputs through a local or remote cache.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install the CLI globally, pin it in the repository and scaffold a workspace.

snippets.code:
# Global install; a pinned repository build still takes precedence
curl -fsSL https://turborepo.dev/install | sh
turbo --version

# Scaffold a workspace with two apps and shared packages
pnpm dlx create-turbo@latest acme
cd acme && pnpm install && pnpm build

# Pin the CLI at the workspace root
pnpm add turbo --save-dev --ignore-workspace-root-check

# Every command then uses the pinned binary
pnpm exec turbo run build

# npm needs no workspace-root flag
npm install turbo --save-dev
npx turbo run build

sections.title: turbo.json
sections.description: Root configuration that declares tasks, global inputs and cache behavior.

sections.title: Pipelines
sections.description: Task graph edges built from same-package steps, upstream builds and explicit package tasks.

snippets.code:
# Print every task, its dependencies and the hash it would use
turbo run build --dry=json

# Render the same graph as SVG, or as DOT on stdout
turbo run build --graph=graph.svg
turbo run build --graph

sections.title: Caching
sections.description: Content-addressed local cache keyed by inputs, lockfile, environment and task configuration.

snippets.code:
# Drop local artifacts, then run twice: execute, then replay
rm -rf .turbo/cache
turbo run build
turbo run build

# Write a JSON report with hashes, inputs and outputs per task
turbo run build --summarize
ls .turbo/runs

# Re-run and overwrite artifacts even on a cache hit
turbo run build --force

# Use a cache directory outside the default .turbo/cache
turbo run build --cache-dir=./.cache/turbo

# Stay offline: read and write the local cache only
turbo run build --cache=local:rw

sections.title: Remote Cache
sections.description: Share artifacts across machines and CI through Vercel or a self-hosted endpoint.

snippets.code:
# Authenticate, then connect this repository to its remote cache
turbo login
turbo link

# Upload once, clear local artifacts, then replay from the server
turbo run build
rm -rf .turbo/cache
turbo run build

# Self-hosted cache: point the CLI at the server and use a CI token
export TURBO_API="https://cache.acme.dev"
export TURBO_TEAM="acme"
export TURBO_TOKEN="cache-token-from-vault"
turbo login --manual

# Sign artifacts so a corrupted upload or download becomes a cache miss
export TURBO_REMOTE_CACHE_SIGNATURE_KEY="acme-cache-signing-key-2026-11-rotate"

sections.title: Filters
sections.description: Select packages by name, directory, dependency direction or git range.

snippets.code:
# One package by name, one by directory, one by dependent direction
turbo run build --filter=web
turbo run build --filter=./apps/*
turbo run build --filter=...web

# web plus its dependencies, then only the dependencies without web
turbo run build --filter=web...
turbo run build --filter=web^...

# A single task in a single package, skipping its task graph
turbo run web#build --only

# Packages changed since main, plus everything that depends on them
turbo run test --filter=...[main]

# Directory globs combine as a union, negation removes matches
turbo run lint --filter=./packages/* --filter=!./packages/legacy

sections.title: Running Tasks
sections.description: Execute one or more tasks with concurrency, failure handling and log control.

snippets.code:
# turbo is shorthand for turbo run; several tasks share one graph
turbo build lint test
turbo run build --concurrency=50%
turbo run test --continue

# Keep going after failures and replay only cache misses
turbo run build test --continue=always --output-logs=new-only

# Inspect the plan, including hashes, inputs and env vars, without running
turbo run build --dry=json

# Watch mode re-runs tasks affected by file changes
turbo watch build lint

# Serial execution with ordered logs for debugging a flaky task
turbo run build --concurrency=1 --log-order=stream

sections.title: Environment Variables
sections.description: Declare which variables enter the hash and which pass through to the task runtime.

snippets.code:
# Show which variables entered the hash for each task
turbo run build --dry=json | jq '.tasks[0].environmentVariables'

# Temporary escape hatch while adding missing variables
turbo run build --env-mode=loose

sections.title: Monorepo Layout
sections.description: Workspace roots, application and package folders, and the root scripts that tie them together.

snippets.code:
acme/
├── apps/
│   ├── web/                 # customer-facing Next.js app
│   └── docs/                # documentation site
├── packages/
│   ├── ui/                  # shared React components
│   ├── config/              # shared tsconfig and ESLint presets
│   └── api-client/          # typed client generated from OpenAPI
├── package.json             # private root with workspace scripts
├── pnpm-lock.yaml
├── pnpm-workspace.yaml
└── turbo.json

packages:
  - "apps/*"
  - "packages/*"

sections.title: Continuous Integration
sections.description: Reuse the remote cache, run only affected packages and keep build contexts small.

snippets.code:
name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm exec turbo run lint test build --affected
        env:
          TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }}
          TURBO_TEAM: acme

# Mirror the CI run locally against the remote cache
export TURBO_TOKEN="ci-token-from-secret-store"
export TURBO_TEAM="acme"
turbo run build test --affected --cache=local:rw,remote:rw

# Reduce a Docker build context to one app and its workspace dependencies
turbo prune web --docker --out-dir=out
